role: Independent verifier, frozen before candidate inspection
target: K=4, distance at least3, logical controlled-S diag(1,1,1,i) from physical tensor products diag(1,i**w_j)
amplitudes: positive square roots of exact rational probabilities; no overlap or signed-amplitude extension
bit_order: leftmost bit is physical qubit0 and corresponds to physical_weights[0]
exact_checks: positive exact probabilities and unit normalization
identical exact one- and two-body Z moments
constant physical mod4 phase on each codeword support matching fixed CS target up to one common global phase
proof_reduction: Disjoint support gives orthogonality and zero diagonal-Pauli off-diagonal entries; union distance3 annihilates every Pauli containing X/Y of total weight<=2; common Z/ZZ moments make remaining diagonal entries scalar. All Pauli operators of weight<=2 are therefore detectable, and all arbitrary single-qubit errors are correctable by KL.
nonadditivity_scope: If all checks pass, physical S powers are Clifford while logical |trace|^2=10 excludes a logical Clifford, hence code is not a Pauli stabilizer code. No claim of inequivalence under arbitrary local unitaries.
failure_scope: A failed support-distance sufficient condition does not prove the code violates general KL; overlapping/signed codes require another verifier.
limits: no decoder/encoder/syndrome circuit or device execution
no noise threshold or correlated-error claim
confirmation_requirements: candidate JSON SHA256 supplied after builder freeze
verifier source and spec hashes recorded
